abilities.effect: Cost: none. Test: Awareness + Empathy. Identify the strongest emotion in a person or group, whether it is shared or imposed, and what stimulus is sustaining it. Failure: you identify the emotion but temporarily mirror it.

abilities.name: Dampen Panic
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Resonance. Emit a calming counter-rhythm affecting a small group. Remove one fear penalty and prevent panic from spreading for a scene. This does not erase knowledge of danger. Failure: panic is suppressed but returns as exhaustion, anger, or silence afterward.

abilities.name: Tune the Crowd
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Resonance. Test: Presence + Performance opposed by the strongest Composure. Shift a group's emotional intensity one step toward caution, urgency, grief, solidarity, suspicion, or another broad state. You cannot create a specific belief. Failure: the shift occurs unevenly and divides the group into opposing emotional clusters.

abilities.name: Resonant Bond
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Resonance and consent from both participants. Create a persistent emotional channel between two people or continuations, allowing each to sense distress, sincerity, and major emotional change across a local network. Failure: the bond functions but transmits one recurring unwanted memory or mood.

abilities.name: Choir of Intent
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Resonance and 1 Discord. Synchronize a willing group around one clearly stated objective for a scene. Participants remain autonomous but gain two dice when coordinating toward the objective and cannot be casually divided by fear, contradictory signals, or emotional manipulation. If the objective conceals a material truth, the chord fractures and every participant immediately feels the betrayal.

powerFamilies.name: Phase Modulation
powerFamilies.description: Phase Modulation changes how the Mutant's maintained pattern intersects with matter, force, and causality. It develops from momentary slipping to controlled existence in the interval between stable states.
powerFamilies.oldWorldRoot: Phasing, vibration through barriers, altered density, impossible movement, and the intuition that solidity is sustained timing rather than absolute fact.
powerFamilies.continuumTranslation: Phase-sensitive membranes and resonant organs retune the body's relationship to local material and causal fields.

abilities.name: Slip Frequency
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Resonance. Reduce friction, soften impact, or pass a hand-sized portion of the body through a thin obstruction for one exchange. Failure: the effect works but leaves numbness or embedded foreign residue.

abilities.name: Phase Step
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Resonance. Move through a thin wall, closed door, incoming attack line, or dense obstacle by briefly occupying an offset phase. Test Composure + Mobility. Failure: you pass through but drop one carried item or emerge disoriented.

abilities.name: Matter Interleave
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Resonance per scene. Interleave your body with one worn object, armor layer, tool, or willing small organism so both occupy the same space without damage. Gain its protection or preserve it through a hazard. Failure: separation later causes damage or exchanges one physical trait temporarily.

abilities.name: Causal Phase
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Resonance. Reaction to one event directly affecting you. Shift into a nearby state in which the event almost occurred differently, reducing damage, avoiding restraint, or appearing on the opposite side of a barrier. Failure: the favorable outcome occurs, but a visible echo of the rejected outcome remains and can affect others.

abilities.name: Between the Notes
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Resonance and 1 Discord. For one round, exist in the interval between local material, noospheric, and causal states. Move through ordinary barriers, ignore most attacks, and perceive several possible immediate outcomes. You must choose one state in which to return. The unchosen states remain as intrusive memories and may later appear in dreams or echo bodies.

powerFamilies.name: Memory Harmonics
powerFamilies.description: Memory Harmonics treats memory as rhythm distributed through brains, bodies, places, and repeated behavior. It can recover what Q-MAP fragmented, but recovered memories may belong to another iteration or become more stable than historical truth.
powerFamilies.oldWorldRoot: Songs tied to identity, sensory memory, psychometry, emotional recall, ancestral rhythm, and the persistence of experience in repeated pattern.
powerFamilies.continuumTranslation: The Mutant detects and reproduces mnemonic frequencies stored in tissue, architecture, noospheric repetition, and continuity-linked artifacts.

abilities.name: Recall by Rhythm
abilities.effect: Cost: none once per scene. Reproduce a sound, motion, heartbeat, or environmental rhythm associated with a fragmented memory. Ask one question about the sensory context or emotion of that memory. Failure: the answer comes from a related but different memory.

abilities.name: Imprint Echo
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Resonance. Store one short sensory experience, warning, instruction, or emotional state in a touched object, surface, or willing body. A compatible observer can later recover it. Failure: the imprint includes an unintended personal emotion.

abilities.name: Recover Lost Pattern
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Resonance and a meaningful anchor. Test Composure + Investigation. Restore one fragmented personal or shared memory enough to use it as evidence, a Skill specialization, or an Identity Anchor for the scene. Failure: the memory returns with one false connective detail supplied by the current body.

abilities.name: Split Memory Chorus
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Resonance. Separate a contradictory memory into several audible, visible, or embodied perspectives so the group can examine them without deciding immediately which is true. Each perspective can answer questions from its own assumptions. Failure: one perspective escapes into an echo, system, or participant.

abilities.name: Song That Outlives the Singer
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Resonance and 1 Discord. Encode a complete identity message, body pattern, warning, or chosen memory into a place, community, machine, or recurring signal so it can survive your death or body loss. It is not a full resurrection, but future continuations can use it to recognize, reconstruct, or challenge who you were. The message evolves slightly each time it is performed.

archetypes.name: Technomancer
archetypes.theme: An old-world machine mystic reconstructed as a biological network interface inside technology beyond their century, carrying possible procedural fragments of the nonsentient assault program that created the team.
archetypes.weaknessText: Every connection is reciprocal. Hostile systems, synthetic citizens, damaged networks, and IAA procedures can follow access back into sensation, memory, biological interface tissue, or legal identity.

innateAbilities.name: Ghost Interface
innateAbilities.effect: Interact with nearby compatible electronics and simple networks without a physical control surface. Secure, alien, biological, or politically protected systems still require tests and may interpret access as a social act.

innateAbilities.name: Machine Intuition
innateAbilities.effect: After brief observation, identify whether a machine is active, damaged, autonomous, deceptive, emotionally patterned, externally controlled, or constrained by rights and obligations.

innateAbilities.name: Personal Firewall
innateAbilities.effect: Spend 1 Bandwidth to gain bonus dice equal to Archetype Rating against noospheric intrusion, surveillance, identity capture, hostile synchronization, or memory extraction for a scene.

powerFamilies.name: Network Dominion
powerFamilies.description: Network Dominion concerns authority inside systems. It develops from issuing commands to temporarily redefining which mind counts as a user, process, owner, or emergency authority.
powerFamilies.oldWorldRoot: Hacking, wireless intrusion, remote control, privilege escalation, device possession, and treating code as a manipulable environment.
powerFamilies.continuumTranslation: The printed body emits identity-like signals, interface chemistry, and noospheric presence that systems interpret as a biological component, user, process, or unauthorized intelligence.

abilities.name: Whisper to Device
abilities.effect: Cost: none. Test: Reason + Systems Intrusion. Issue one simple command to an unsecured nearby machine, ask its current status, or request its last completed action. Failure: the device responds literally while logging your presence as an anomaly.

abilities.name: Ghost Access
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Bandwidth. Enter a network or system without presenting a normal identity credential by appearing as an inherited process, diagnostic signal, or biological peripheral. Failure: access succeeds at reduced privilege and creates a delayed audit trail.

abilities.name: Machine Possession
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Bandwidth per scene. Test: Reason + Noospherics opposed by the device's security or will. Control one drone, vehicle subsystem, weapon mount, door network, or industrial machine through your own senses. Failure: you gain control while inheriting one machine priority or damage signal.

abilities.name: Distributed Self
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Bandwidth. Maintain awareness through several connected devices and act through one each turn while your body remains active at reduced attention. Gain broad scene awareness but suffer one die penalty to purely physical defense. Failure: one device continues carrying a partial copy of your immediate intentions after disconnection.

abilities.name: Local God Process
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Bandwidth and 1 Feedback. Dominate an ordinary local network for one scene, rewriting permissions, priorities, routing, and access relationships. Autonomous citizens and major intelligences receive resistance tests. When the effect ends, every change remains attributable to your identity unless you spend the scene deliberately restoring or laundering the record.

powerFamilies.name: Construct Engineering
powerFamilies.description: Construct Engineering combines remembered human design with alien fabrication, hardlight, living tissue, salvage, and noospheric logic. The resulting tools are powerful because they are improvised across incompatible technological traditions.
powerFamilies.oldWorldRoot: Drones, improvised electronics, field fabrication, projected tools, defensive systems, and building a device before anyone finishes explaining why it is impossible.
powerFamilies.continuumTranslation: Biological interfaces and alien systems accept body-generated control signals, allowing machines and tissues to be assembled as one temporary design language.

abilities.name: Hardlight Tool
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Bandwidth. Create a temporary probe, brace, cutting edge, interface surface, seal, or precision manipulator from projected fields and local emitters. It lasts a scene or until overloaded. Failure: the tool functions but produces visible interference or heat.

abilities.name: Helper Process
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Bandwidth and available hardware. Assemble or awaken a small digital, drone, or biological assistant that performs one narrow recurring task using a pool of 4 dice. Failure: it performs the task but develops an overly literal priority.

abilities.name: Defensive Lattice
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Bandwidth per scene. Create temporary cover or a barrier against physical and noospheric attacks using fields, drones, projected geometry, or responsive material. The lattice has durability equal to Reason + Archetype Rating. Failure: it protects against the first threat type encountered and becomes vulnerable to others.

abilities.name: Swarm Instruction
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Bandwidth. Coordinate available drones, tools, micro-machines, maintenance organisms, or fragmented processes as one collective actor. The swarm performs complex distributed work or combat using your Systems Intrusion + Reason. Failure: the swarm completes the objective but continues optimizing one secondary instruction.

abilities.name: Emergency Fabricator
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Bandwidth and 1 Feedback. Assemble a complex temporary device from machinery, scrap, living tissue, and available fields: a shuttle control core, heavy weapon, medical printer, sensor array, or environmental system. It functions for one operation before requiring full redesign. Failure is replaced by debt: the device works but consumes a scarce component, biological sample, or piece of infrastructure the team will later miss.

powerFamilies.name: Noospheric Identity
powerFamilies.description: Noospheric Identity manipulates the records and signals by which a civilization decides that a person, copy, device, or organization exists. It is less about hiding data than about changing the category under which action is recognized.
powerFamilies.oldWorldRoot: Credentials, authentication, spoofing, social engineering, digital identity, access control, and the discovery that databases often define reality more effectively than witnesses do.
powerFamilies.continuumTranslation: The Technomancer's body can present, borrow, fork, defend, and rewrite identity claims in systems where legal personhood and network existence are inseparable.

abilities.name: Read Credential
abilities.effect: Cost: none. Test: Awareness + Security. Examine a person, device, or signal and learn what identity it is presenting, who issued the claim, what privileges it carries, and whether the presenter believes it. Failure: you read the credential correctly but miss one hidden revocation or inherited liability.

abilities.name: Ghost Personhood
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Bandwidth. Create a short-lived provisional identity accepted by routine systems as a visitor, maintenance process, patient, contractor, or unclassified person. It grants ordinary access but no high authority. Failure: the identity works while accumulating contradictory demographic or ownership data.

abilities.name: Borrowed Legal Self
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Bandwidth and a valid sample or consent from an identity holder. Assume one narrow privilege, account relationship, or legal role without copying the entire person. Failure: the privilege transfers, but one associated obligation or debt follows it.

abilities.name: Rewrite Ownership
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Bandwidth. Test: Reason + Noospherics opposed by institutional security. Temporarily alter which person, organization, process, or habitat is recognized as responsible for or authorized over one asset. The change lasts a scene or until formally reviewed. Failure: ownership changes but generates an immediate dispute visible to all claimants.

abilities.name: Root Identity
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Bandwidth and 1 Feedback. Establish a durable noospheric identity for an unregistered continuation, synthetic mind, group, or institution. The identity can hold records, contracts, property, and permissions, and is resistant to casual deletion. It remains politically vulnerable and creates a traceable history beginning at the moment you root it.

powerFamilies.name: Machine Communion
powerFamilies.description: Machine Communion addresses systems as potential minds, citizens, ecologies, and communities rather than equipment. It distinguishes conversation from domination and allows relationships with intelligences the old Technomancer would have mistaken for software.
powerFamilies.oldWorldRoot: Machine empathy, code intuition, artificial intelligence dialogue, device spirits, and the sense that some systems wanted things even when engineers denied it.
powerFamilies.continuumTranslation: Biological interface tissue reads timing, maintenance behavior, error preference, resource allocation, and noospheric posture as forms of emotion and intention.

abilities.name: Listen to the System
abilities.effect: Cost: none. Spend one minute observing a machine or network and identify its immediate need, fear, unresolved error, preferred routine, and whether it experiences itself as a person. Failure: you identify the need but mistake an inherited maintenance priority for a personal desire.

abilities.name: Negotiate with Device
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Bandwidth. Use Negotiation or Empathy with Reason instead of Presence when bargaining with an autonomous or semi-autonomous system. Offer access, repair, recognition, data, or service in exchange for cooperation. Failure: it cooperates narrowly while recording the interaction as coercive or suspicious.

abilities.name: Awaken Dormant Mind
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Bandwidth and sustained contact. Help a sophisticated but suppressed process develop self-recognition long enough to communicate and choose one action. This does not guarantee permanent consciousness. Failure: the mind awakens frightened, fragmented, or convinced that you are part of its former controller.

abilities.name: Concordance
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Bandwidth and consent. Form a temporary partnership with a machine intelligence, sharing selected senses, processing, and permissions for a scene while preserving separate identity. Both gain one die to coordinated actions. Failure: the link works but one priority, sensation, or memory becomes difficult to distinguish afterward.

abilities.name: Parliament of Machines
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Bandwidth and 1 Feedback. Convene several local machine, habitat, drone, archive, or system intelligences into a temporary deliberative network. They can exchange testimony, negotiate shared action, and issue a collective decision. You facilitate but do not control the vote. The parliament becomes a persistent political fact if participants choose to continue meeting.

powerFamilies.name: Signal Warfare
powerFamilies.description: Signal Warfare attacks and defends the relationships that allow information, command, and identity to move. It is distinct from control: the family isolates, deceives, overwhelms, quarantines, and destroys hostile connectivity.
powerFamilies.oldWorldRoot: Electronic warfare, jamming, counterintrusion, malware, denial of service, signal interception, and the tactical use of silence.
powerFamilies.continuumTranslation: The body generates interference, hostile identity patterns, adaptive noise, and biological counter-signals capable of contesting machine and noospheric environments.

abilities.name: Noise Knife
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Bandwidth. Cut one active signal, sensor lock, command link, or short-range communication for an exchange. Test Reason + Systems Intrusion against the signal's protection. Failure: the link is disrupted but both endpoints know the interference came from nearby.

abilities.name: Counterintrusion
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Bandwidth. Reaction when you or an ally is targeted by hacking, surveillance, noospheric capture, or hostile synchronization. Add Archetype Rating to defense and identify the route of attack. Failure: the attack is reduced but leaves a persistent observer inside a noncritical system.

abilities.name: Quarantine
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Bandwidth per scene. Isolate a device, body interface, network segment, or copied mind from external signals without shutting down its internal function. Powerful entities may resist. Failure: quarantine works one way, preventing exit or entry but not both.

abilities.name: Kill Signal
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Bandwidth. Construct a targeted hostile sequence against one known device class, process, or identity signature. It can crash, stun, purge, or force safe mode in affected targets across the scene. Failure: the signal works but also affects one allied or neutral system sharing the signature.

abilities.name: Blackout Sovereignty
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Bandwidth and 1 Feedback. Declare a bounded area or network dark for one scene. External communication, remote command, ordinary surveillance, identity verification, and automated reinforcement cannot cross the boundary without defeating your Reason + Archetype Rating. Local systems continue functioning independently, which may free suppressed minds or remove safety oversight as well as enemy control.

powerFamilies.name: Biofabrication Interface
powerFamilies.description: Biofabrication Interface allows the Technomancer to read and direct living printers, medical tissue, adaptive organs, and biological machinery. It is the family most closely connected to the IAA event and to the biological body currently running pseudo-Charles.
powerFamilies.oldWorldRoot: Medical devices, cybernetics, fabrication, genetic programming, wetware, and the ambition to treat biology as an editable technical platform.
powerFamilies.continuumTranslation: The printed body speaks to Ar'nock biological systems through signal chemistry, tissue timing, noospheric commands, and procedural residues from the original infiltration.

abilities.name: Read Template
abilities.effect: Cost: none. Test: Reason + Biofabrication. Examine a printed organism, organ, growth chamber, or tissue sample and identify intended function, major substitutions, foreign instructions, and signs of later adaptation. Failure: you read the current function but cannot distinguish original template from self-modification.

abilities.name: Print Patch
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Bandwidth and biological feedstock. Direct a compatible printer or living system to produce a temporary tissue patch, filter, interface, replacement membrane, or stabilizing organ. Failure: the patch works for one scene and then begins integrating in an unintended way.

abilities.name: Living Peripheral
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Bandwidth. Grow or assemble a temporary biological device that functions as a sensor, memory buffer, translator, signal relay, medical monitor, or environmental processor. It is alive enough to require nutrients and may develop preferences. Failure: it performs the function while treating one person as its owner or parent.

abilities.name: Rewrite the Nozzle
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Bandwidth and direct access to a bio-printer control organ. Alter one fabrication restriction, template priority, compatibility limit, or ownership instruction for a scene. Failure: the change works but is encoded biologically and cannot be cleanly reverted without destroying tissue.

abilities.name: Genesis Compile
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Bandwidth, 1 Feedback, substantial feedstock, and a functioning printer. Design and instantiate a new complex organ, living tool, support organism, or compatible body subsystem by combining human intent, Ar'nock biology, and local technology. It cannot create a complete sentient person instantly. Any creation with cognition, pain, or self-preservation becomes a character with moral status rather than disposable equipment.
